sentences.text:
Being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and award passed by the Tribunal,
the present appeal is preferred by insurance company.

3. Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.
4.

Learned advocate for the appellant has raised many contentions before this Court, however, it need not be considered as the amount involved in this appeal is very small, which need not be challenged by the appellant, considering the fact that the accident has occurred and the claimant got injured.
Therefore, on the ground of smallness of amount / petty amount involved in the appeal, the present appeal need not be entertained and is required to be dismissed.
5. In view of above, the following order is passed.
6.1 The present appeal is dismissed with no order as to costs.

6.2 The Tribunal shall disburse the entire awarded amount, along with accrued interest thereon if any, to the claimant, by account payee cheque, after due verification and after following due procedure.
6.3 Record and proceedings be sent back to the concerned Tribunal, forthwith.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT,J) DIWAKAR SHUKLA The New India Assurance Company ... vs Driver Truck No Gj-9-Z-1412 on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36973242/
